page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfg9i.8xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated Intel Xeon 6982P-C vCPUs operating at a clock speed of 3.4 GHz. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of system memory, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. It provides a baseline network bandwidth of 20 Gbps and does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. There is no GPU acceleration available on this instance.

From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high clock speed of 3.4 GHz offer reliable compute performance for workloads requiring consistent processing power without resource contention. The 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio makes this instance suitable for general-purpose workloads, web serving, application servers, and moderate database hosting where local NVMe storage is not a prerequisite.
